{{Quote|Team? I work alone. I don't need anyone's help to take down a human. And I can prove it.|Unidentified Sorrusian mercenary|<ref name="RF4" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sorrusian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was among the many pilots who answered the summons of [[X-7]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], for a high paying job. The group met on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Iope]], in the [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]] system, where their flying skills were tested by X-7. The Sorrusian was among the few survivors of the [[Skirmish on Iope|test]] and was granted safe passage to the hidden hangar on the moon. There, the surviving mercenaries met X-7 and received their mission to kill the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilot [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. When X-7 informed them that they would have to work as a group, the Sorrusian objected and reached for his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. But before he could draw his weapon, X-7 [[Death/Legends|killed]] him with a shot to the head.<ref name="RF4" />
